# DropConvert

> Free, open-source macOS menu bar app for converting image, video, PDF and SVG
> files entirely on-device. No uploads, no account, no subscription.

DropConvert is a native macOS utility (macOS 14 Sonoma or later) that lives in the
menu bar. Drag a file onto the icon, pick an output format, and the converted file
is saved locally. All conversion happens on the Mac; no file is ever sent to a server.

## Supported conversions
- Input: HEIC, PNG, JPG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, GIF, MOV, MP4, AVI, MKV, WebM, PDF, SVG
- Output: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV

## Install
- Direct: https://github.com/mpotter2002/DropConvert/releases/latest
- Homebrew: brew install --cask mpotter2002/tap/dropconvert
- Curl: curl -fsSL https://dropconvert.app/install.sh | bash
- Agent/MCP (macOS, Linux, Windows): pip install git+https://github.com/mpotter2002/DropConvert.git#subdirectory=dropconvert-mcp
